definition: letting most of it through so I can afford the part that matters

settled:
Letting an impulse pass costs nothing. Fighting every one of them empties the budget before the harmful one arrives.

If I do not want to, I cannot. A thing done late is cheaper than a thing forced.

Some of them arrive as an intrusive what-would-happen-if: what if I jumped off this bridge. Before I understood the mechanism they felt possible enough to frighten me. Once I could read one as a signal rather than as intent, it stopped costing me anything.

Letting that thought go by is not a failure of the system. It is the system.

title: What I Do Not Have To Fight
